pr_title: [25.0] daemon: rename: don't reload endpoint from datastore
pr_body:
- Backport https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/47195
- Related to https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/46853
- fixes https://github.com/moby/moby/issues/47186

**- What I did**

Commit 8b7af1d0f added some code to update the DNSNames of all endpoints attached to a sandbox by loading a new instance of each affected endpoints from the datastore through a call to `Network.EndpointByID()`.

This method then calls `Network.getEndpointFromStore()`, that in turn calls `store.GetObject()`, which then calls `cache.get()`, which calls `o.CopyTo(kvObject)`. This effectively creates a fresh new instance of an Endpoint. However, endpoints are already kept in memory by Sandbox, meaning we now have two in-memory instances of the same Endpoint.

As it turns out, libnetwork is built around the idea that no two objects representing the same thing should leave in-memory, otherwise breaking mutex locking and optimistic locking (as both instances will have a drifting version tracking ID -- dbIndex in libnetwork parliance).

In this specific case, this bug materializes by container rename failing when applied a second time for a given container. An integration test is added to make sure this doesn't happen in the future.

**- How I did it**

This is a quick-fix; instead of loading endpoints through `Network.EndpointByID()`, `Sandbox.getEndpoint()` was made public and is now used. I also added a comment on `Network.EndpointByID()` saying this method should *never* be used -- and actually it should be removed in a follow-up.

We should also probably look more closely to the way the datastore, its caching layer, etc... are used and implemented. (see this comment: https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/47195#discussion_r1464035325).

**- How to verify it**

I added an integration test to test that `docker rename` can be called multiple times for the same container.

**- Description for the changelog**

- Fix a bug that prevented a container from being renamed twice

issue_context.title: docker container rename fails
issue_context.body:
### Description

I installed docker-ce 25.0.0 on a fresh Debian bookworm machine using the recommended package source. Then I tried renaming a running container multiple times, from the second try it fails with the error message: 

```
Error response from daemon: Unable to complete atomic operation, key modified
Error: failed to rename container named admiring_beaver.1
```


### Reproduce

1. create a running container: `docker run -it debian:latest bash`
2. find the container name `docker ps -a` -> e.g. name1
3. `docker container rename name1 name2` -> works
4. `docker container rename name2 name3` -> fails

### Expected behavior

`docker container rename` should work without an error.

comments:
Thanks for reporting; Looks to be coming from the kv-db used in the network stack, in either `AtomicDelete` https://github.com/moby/moby/blob/cac52f717320d4d4db8febfd00bd37236e7704d8/libnetwork/internal/kvstore/boltdb/boltdb.go#L240
or `AtomicPut` https://github.com/moby/moby/blob/cac52f717320d4d4db8febfd00bd37236e7704d8/libnetwork/internal/kvstore/boltdb/boltdb.go#L248

@thaJeztah (you posted the same line twice 😉) I was able to reproduce under delve and can confirm it comes from this specific condition (in `AtomicPut`): https://github.com/moby/moby/blob/cac52f717320d4d4db8febfd00bd37236e7704d8/libnetwork/internal/kvstore/boltdb/boltdb.go#L283-L285

Here's the stack trace:

```

go.etcd.io/bbolt.(*DB).Update (db.go:862)
boltdb.(*BoltDB).AtomicPut (boltdb.go:260) github.com/docker/docker/libnetwork/internal/kvstore/boltdb
datastore.(*Store).PutObjectAtomic (datastore.go:202) github.com/docker/docker/libnetwork/datastore
libnetwork.(*Controller).updateToStore (store.go:156) github.com/docker/docker/libnetwork
libnetwork.(*Endpoint).rename (endpoint.go:632) github.com/docker/docker/libnetwork
libnetwork.(*Sandbox).Rename (sandbox.go:228) github.com/docker/docker/libnetwork
daemon.(*Daemon).ContainerRename (rename.go:108) github.com/docker/docker/daemon
```

It's related to this PR: https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/46853.

Whoops! Copy/pasta mistake. Happens all the time 😂
Fixed by https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/47195 / https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/47196 (which will be in v25.0.1
